ETID.split_method: source-group-held-out; category labels only; excluded from anomaly evaluation and normal reference banks

Plastic Shampoo Bottle.split_method: official YOLO train/valid/test image splits; category-only labels kept out of defect and normal-reference evaluation

ETID_source_group_held_out_test.split_method: source-group-held-out ETID test groups; no training/validation source group overlap

plastic_shampoo_bottle_category_test.split_method: official Plastic Shampoo Bottle test split; notebook-checkpoint duplicate paths excluded

product_classifier.distance_reference: separate category_feature_banks.npz; category-only ETID and bottle-subtype images do not enter normal anomaly references

image_level_anomaly_screening.limitation: Uses global average pooled image embeddings; local defect localization is not supported.

important_limit: The product MLP identifies product categories. Wear/damage localization is handled by a separate segmentation model; the MLP does not localize defects.

dataset_notes.PharmaVision: Used Train/Val/Test normal and defective tablet images as the existing pill product category. The downloaded archive contains only binary normal/defective folders and no per-image severity/type table or pixel masks.
dataset_notes.ETID: 6,269 category-labeled e-waste product photos across battery, cable, keyboard, laptop, mobile phone, mouse, and PCB. Source groups are held out globally across train/validation/test. ETID is category-only: it does not label defects and is excluded from normal anomaly references and defect training.
dataset_notes.Plastic Shampoo Bottle: Official bottle defect image splits are used to teach a separate plastic_shampoo_bottle product category; these photos include defects and are not treated as normal references. The bottle-specific YOLO detector alone learns the defect boxes/types/grades.

calibration.method: max F1 on held-out validation images containing normal and masked-defect examples

Shampoo bottle bounding boxes.annotation_type: YOLO boxes rasterized as weak rectangular targets

defect_segmentation.limitations: The U-Net localizes binary candidate regions. Shampoo-bottle bounding boxes are weak rectangular targets, downweighted to 0.25 of the per-image loss and evaluated separately from true pixel masks. The attached type and bottle heads have narrower label scopes; no head certifies general severity or sale suitability.

damage_type_head.architecture: DefectTypeMLP on defect-mask-bounded crops using the shared frozen ResNet-18 encoder
damage_type_head.source: MVTec AD test defect folders and pixel masks; custom stratified-by-folder image splits
damage_type_head.label_mapping: scratch, crack, hole/puncture, cut/tear, broken/damaged, missing/misplaced part, deformation, surface/contamination, or multiple/other
damage_type_head.limitation: Broad types are derived from MVTec folder names, not independently adjudicated severity labels. The classifier is trained only on MVTec defect crops; its clues are not calibrated for unrelated products or camera styles and do not determine sale suitability.

bottle_damage_grade_head.architecture: multi-class defect/grade MLP over defect-region crops and the shared frozen ResNet-18 feature encoder
bottle_damage_grade_head.source: Plastic Shampoo Bottle Dataset, each YOLO bounding-box crop inherits its defect type and grade
bottle_damage_grade_head.limitation: Type and marginal/unacceptable grades apply only to crops resembling this plastic shampoo-bottle dataset. The source has no clean bottle examples; this head classifies already-localized candidate regions and cannot determine defect absence, safety, or sale suitability.

bottle_yolo_detector.scope: Plastic shampoo-bottle subtype only; generic bottles and other categories do not use this model

dataset.test_split: official held-out test split; not used for training or model selection

bottle_yolo_detector.limitation: Annotations cover five defect types and marginal/unacceptable grades on plastic shampoo bottles. The source contains no clean shampoo-bottle images. Missing detections do not establish that an item is defect-free, and the detector is not calibrated for other bottles or products.
